scoring.answerCoverage: all relevant labelled quote bytes appear contiguously in returned agent-visible snippet at the correct path
scoring.noAnswerHit: any result for a query labelled with no relevant quote
scoring.conflictHit: returned path is listed as conflicting for this query
scoring.referenceIntegrity: each returned chunk_id and source_revision resolves via memory_get to the identical source path and includes its snippet

decisionRule.note: Proposed #1346 criteria are used as a predeclared diagnostic gate for this evaluation only; they are not approved production budgets. Both rates must pass for one mode to be recommended as a default.
